title: Shift and reconstruction choices for exceptional transport
statement: For the operation and left-realization families in the core transport hypotheses, one can choose shift-compatibility proofs for every left realization and a normalized reconstruction equivalence at both endpoints for every field stage.

proof.text: Apply the normalized reduction/limit reconstruction theorem to the coefficient sequence at each endpoint, restrict to the normalized bounded subcategories, and transport the inherited shift through the specified left realization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_reconstructions
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s)) :
    Nonempty (TransportCorePreData l Ω D hl c operation left)
